description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Omni-Changeling.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Omni-Changeling.
Activate Omni-Changeling by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Omni-Changeling
uses.cardState: as a copy of Forensic Researcher and without summoning sickness
